# Deliberate policy exemptions, checked against lines that already matched
# forbidden-attribution-patterns.txt. A matching line here is treated as fine
# and dropped before the check decides whether to fail.
#
# GitHub's own Copilot Autofix feature (tied to the CodeQL code scanning
# already enabled on this repo) inserts this exact trailer automatically
# whenever someone accepts one of its automated security-remediation
# suggestions. Treated as a first-party security feature, not an
# AI-authorship shortcut. A plain "Co-authored-by: Copilot <...>" (the
# separate PR-suggestion feature, not tied to a security fix) is NOT covered
# by this line and still gets blocked.
copilot autofix powered by ai
